newsitem.title: FRANCE: Congo president sees Mobutu in France.
newsitem.headline: Congo president sees Mobutu in France.

text.p: Congolese President Pascal Lissouba went to southern France on Monday to meet Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko and left for Rome two hours later without making any statement.

French officials said Lissouba had flown in from Geneva and was driven to the sprawling luxury villa at Roquebrune-Cap Martin on the Riviera where Mobutu arrived last week after months of medical treatment in Switzerland.

His visit came as a French news agency said a company of 120 French soldiers based in the West African state of Gabon were about to fly to the Congo capital Brazzaville in readiness for action in strife-torn Zaire whose capital Kinshasa is just across the Zaire river from Brazzaville.
French officials said they had no comment on the news agency report.

France is trying to enlist allies to create an international force to bring aid to refugees in eastern Zaire. But French authorities have so far said they would not move into Zaire without an international mandate, preferably from the United Nations which has so far failed to decide on the matter.
